turns.speaker: Student
turns.text: Come on, Dr. Lee, admit it, we're just two actors in a high school play and I'm playing the role of a clueless but lovable teenager who's constantly saying I'll eat this, I'll do that, and I'm really, really fat, but you're playing the part of a clueless but lovable physics teacher who's trying to get me to remember the periodic table, backwards, and say the most ridiculous things, like bye to the electrons, I mean, the protons. So can we just drop the charade already and have a real conversation?
